projects.name: NHDOT Projects Proposals - Projects In Design
projects.notes: Layer description: PROJECTS_ALL staging table queried by PROJECT_TYPE = 'Design' And HAS_ROW_PLANS = 'NO'. NOT VERIFIED WITH DATA. The layer definition (name, geometry type, field list) answered on 2026-11-16/17, but every query on every layer of this server's Projects services returned HTTP 200 with {"error":{"code":500,"message":"Error performing query operation"}} - on MapServer and FeatureServer, with count-only, ids-only and single-field queries. It looks like a database outage on NHDOT's side, so retry later. Field names are copied from the layer definition, but which field means what is a GUESS from the names because no sample record could be read (in particular PRIMARY_TIER as work type and PROJECT_DOLLARS vs TYP_INFLATED_COST vs BID_TOTAL as cost are unconfirmed; there is no town/county field in the list). Record count unknown.
